tbesh_html:
Someone descended from Periz(?), first mentioned at Gen.13.7
§ Perizzite = "belonging to a village"
a people who inhabited southern Canaan prior to the conquest

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a Perizzite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
strongs_1890.derivation: for H6521 (פְּרָזִי); inhabitant of the open country;
